name: Kefah Bates
bio: Founder & Visionary Dedicated to raising consciousness Kefah has made it her life's work to share the power of healing and to make it accessible to all. Her vision came from decades spent as a healer and spiritual teacher, researching in to what limits us from developing our higher potential. Kefah is now an author, speaker, teacher and visionary of the School of Unified Healing. Her books focus on how we acheive liberation and how to open to the true self, these are 'Live The Life of Empowerment', 'Healing truths' and 'The 3 Keys To Spiritual Success.'

name: David Graham
bio: Co-Founder & Visionary David is a guiding force behind many of the Schools develpoments. His work is centred on raising the collective consciousness and fostering deep personal growth. His life has been in the pursuit of truth and understanding the nature of suffering and what lies beyond this. As a strong advocate of self-empowerment David continues to pioneer further Schools for the education of healing for all.

name: Aviva Kovalenko
bio: Aviva believes transformation doesn’t come from escaping life, but from learning to meet it fully — embracing the body, emotions, pleasure, discomfort and every part of the human experience. Having experienced depression and the feeling of being stuck and disconnected in the corporate world herself, supporting others in experiencing life with greater presence, freedom and aliveness has become her true passion. Rooted in the philosophy of Non-Dual Shaiva Tantra, she is an ecstatic dance DJ, somatic movement facilitator, Yin Yoga and meditation teacher, and Tantra practitioner. Through music, movement and embodied practices, she creates experiences that invite people to feel more, express more, and experience the fullness of being alive. Contact Aviva Here

name: Loto Vazquez
bio: Loto went from bullied, and lost in taking and selling drugs as a teenager, to finding and living his purpose and becoming an author, speaker, philanthropist, mentor & investor. He also earned a Masters Degree in Philosophy and was a Meditation Practice Monk for more than 10 years, and has supported thousands of people and organizations online and offline for the last 25 years to align and live their true purposes. Contact Loto Here

name: Lisa Ascher
bio: Lisa’s life experience is all about journeys above and below water. She is a passionate yoga and freediving instructor as well as a shamanic and quantum healing practitioner. Her favorite space to be is the liminal space in between sleep and awake, between inhale and exhale, between earth and sky, between death and life. She offer 1:1 cellular release sessions and higher self connection regressive therapy. Contact Lisa Here

name: Zineb El Gharbaoui
bio: Zineb is a Moroccan-born facilitator carrying a feminine ancestral gift passed down through her lineage. Rooted in ancient Moroccan wisdom, her work bridges embodiment, spirituality, and ancestral remembrance, guiding women to transform pain into power and return to the sacred essence of creation within. Contact Zineb Here

name: Sea
bio: Sea is an artist who transforms emotions into vibrant expressions of color and shape. Rooted in the concept of "nothing," a meditative state where the mind quiets and emotions flow freely, his work reflects honesty, presence, and deep emotional connection. Through his art, Sea turns pain into beauty, creating pieces that inspire healing and self-discovery. Contact Sea Here

name: Daria
bio: Daria is a sound therapist, psychologist, coach in different areas of life, musician & author of unique song albums, creator of on-line and off-line programms, courses of the activation of the Natural Voice and other unique talents. Leader of kirtans and concerts, Reiki master. Contact Daria Here

name: Umut
bio: Umut Oz is a certified astrologer (ISAR) with five years of experience, specializing in evolutionary astrology, shadow work, and life purpose. With an academic background art direction and a academic history in IT and sociology, he brings a unique perspective that blends analytical insight with creative intuition. His work integrates astrology, psychology, and energy healing, guiding individuals through deep healing and self-discovery. In addition to his consultations, he co-hosts a podcast and produces a YouTube series exploring astrology, psychology, technology, and community. He enjoys ecstatic dance, kirtan, and exploring the vibrant landscapes of Bali. Contact Umut Here

name: Adrian Bajenaru
bio: Founder of somaticshaking.com & Author of ‘Unshakable: Shake your body, free your mind’ I specialize in discharging trauma, anxiety, and tension. With a BA in Psychology and 17 years of teaching Yoga and Taoist Alchemy, I bridge clinical science with ancient somatic wisdom. My approach is transparent and direct: we bypass talk therapy to resolve stress at a cellular level. Through somatic shaking, functional breathwork, and kundalini embodiment, I help you move from "fight-or-flight" into an unshakable state of presence. Contact Adrian Here

name: I Made Suparta
bio: I Made Suparta is a certified yoga instructor and really wants to share Bali joyful living yoga or laughter yoga for healthy, healing and happiness. After spending more than 10 years working as a tour driver and guide and now transform become more spiritual, new chapter in his life. Contact Made Here

name: Kogie
bio: Kogie’s journey into sound healing began in 2006, during her Reiki training. She remembers so vividly the moment her Reiki instructor introduced a Tibetan sound bowl into our session. The sound stirred something deep within her, something far beyond what the mind could grasp. She felt an unexpected release, a wave of peace, calm, and pure energy that touched her soul. Today, She continues to expand her collection of instruments, always seeking new ways to bring these sacred frequencies to others. She truly believes that frequency is the new currency and through it, we can usher in a wave of quantum healing that our world so deeply needs. Contact Kogie Here

name: Oksana St John
bio: Oksana is certified RYT-200 yoga teacher specializing in Yin, Hatha, meditation, and self-inquiry-based practices. Her teaching focuses on slow, grounded, breath-led classes that support students physically, mentally, and energetically. Contact Oksana Here

name: Anna Burmistrova
bio: Anna is a psychologist, body-oriented therapist, gestalt therapist, art-therapist and group facilitator with over 11 years of experience. she guides spaces where people can reconnect with their bodies, feel deeply, and relate with honesty and care. In her work, she combines somatic awareness, creativity, and gentle presence. She believes that coming back to the body is a way home — to aliveness, clarity, and connection. Contact Anna Here

name: Tracey Jarvis
bio: 400-Hour Kundalini Yoga Teacher | Sound Healer | Chakra Healer | Global Retreat Leader | Soul-Led Business Mentor With 25 years of experience practicing and teaching yoga, Tracey blends Kundalini Yoga, crystal bowl sound healing, chakra healing, and soul-led mentorship to guide people through transformational classes, retreats, and energetic work. She creates powerful spaces that release blocks, awaken clarity, and reconnect you to your truth—supporting deep healing, alignment, and the activation of your highest potential. Contact Tracey Here

name: Matt Laing
bio: Matt is an Ancestral Healing Practitioner and transformation coach from New Zealand. He helps individuals establish clear, honoured boundaries and build strong, vibrant relationships with wise and loving ancestors. His grounded, intuitive presence creates a calm and safe ritual space - especially for those who struggle with intuition or holding boundaries. Whether you’re at a threshold, navigating transition, or seeking deeper purpose, Matt supports you to meet your well and loving ancestors in a field of remembrance, sovereignty, and love. Contact Matt Here

name: Sophie Satori
bio: A nature lover & yoga teacher with 550 hours of teacher training - 200 hours in India, 300 hours in Bali and 50 hours of Yin Yoga training in Bali. My approach is rooted in holding sacred, safe and nourishing space for others to slow down and connect with self and nature. I love to do this through guiding mindful movement, breath, mantra, stillness and self-exploration. Contact Sophie Here

name: Subba Sattvic
bio: Subba Sattvic is a spiritual guide from India who lives and teaches in Ubud and across Asia. Rooted in Vedic and Upanishadic chanting since childhood, his path has been shaped by years of silent retreats and deep study of Patanjali’s Yoga Sutras and Bhagavan Ramana Maharshi’s Vedanta. What makes his journey unique is his training in engineering and business, and three decades in banking leadership—all while deepening his inner path. Subba’s teachings blend timeless Indian wisdom with modern life experience, gently guiding seekers toward stillness, clarity, and love. Contact Subba Here

name: Audilia Kanaan
bio: Audilia is a trauma-informed soul guide, relationship counselor, and intuitive facilitator. She helps people reconnect with their inner truth through womb healing, inner child work, and embodied practices. Her work blends depth, practicality, and intuition to support healing and transformation. Contact Audilia Here

name: Marnie Hodgson
bio: Through her offerings, Marnie creates space for students to embody truth. To return to inner wisdom through movement, meditation and self-expression. Her purpose is rooted in lived experience. Originally from the UK, yoga and meditation were her ticket out of a life where she felt powerless, burned out, and small. Her curiosity led her across the world and, more importantly, inward. To a deeper truth that continues to shape both her approach to life and her teaching. With a background in brand storytelling, entrepreneurship and the arts, Marnie brings a uniquely creative essence to her teaching. Marnie has completed over 500 hours of training in Power Yoga, Meditation and Pranayama, Empowerment Yoga, and Hands-on Adjustments. She now calls Bali home, but teaches workshops worldwide. Contact Marnie Here

name: Scarlett
bio: With over four years of teaching experience, Scarlett specializes in Yin, Hatha, and Inside Flow, guiding students through intentional movement and mindful alignment. Off the mat, her work as an event manager keeps her firmly planted in the hustle of today’s fast-paced world. This duality has taught her the true art of balance. She brings the grounded, soulful energy of her life in Bali into every class she teaches, creating a safe, supportive space for students to find their own equilibrium. Passionate about the deeper mind-body connection, Scarlett loves to weave traditional yoga philosophy into her sessions, sharing practical wisdom that resonates both on and off the mat. Through intuitive, hands-on adjustments and clear cues, her goal is to help you release what feels stuck, explore your edges, and find the perfect harmony between modern living and inner peace. Contact Scarlett Here

name: Koné
bio: Koné is a musician from Mali who studied music in Germany and has embraced both traditional and contemporary music. His work brings ancestral African rhythms, movement and communal vibration into a space of presence, connection and joy. For Koné, music is not only about making sound it is a way to reconnect with ourselves, our bodies and each other, inspired by the wisdom and traditions passed down through generations. Contact Koné Here

name: Daniel Alchemy
bio: Daniel is an Ikigai Mentor and Life Alchemist, guiding people who feel there is “more” toward clarity, purpose, and meaningful work. Originally from Austria, he has spent the last years living, traveling, and working across cultures — questioning success, identity, and what work is truly meant to be. Through uncertainty, loss, and rebuilding his own life, he discovered that clarity comes not from doing more, but from listening more honestly. For over seven years, Daniel has studied and lived the philosophy of Ikigai, supporting others in aligning what they love, what they are good at, what the world needs, and what can sustainably support their life. His work creates space — to slow down, reconnect, and translate inner clarity into conscious direction. Contact Daniel Here

name: Siddha Yogi Raj
bio: 18 Siddha Yogi Raj is a traditional Spiritual mentor with over 18 years of teaching experiences across India and internationally. His teachings combine Kundalini Yoga, Kriya Yoga, breathwork, meditation, yogic philosophy, and holistic healing practices. He has guided thousands of students through transformational retreats, yoga teacher trainings, and spiritual workshops focused on self-awareness and conscious living. Contact Siddha Here

name: Rutger
bio: Rutger is 41 years old and from the Netherlands. From a young age, he experienced a deep, unconscious sense of unsafety that made the conventional path of life—house, relationship, and career—feel difficult and unfamiliar. Rather than accepting this feeling, he began searching for the reasons behind feeling different and not belonging. From the age of 15, Rutger has explored the unconscious survival instinct through many approaches, from spiritual practices and plant medicines to psychological and more grounded methods. Each experience helped him understand himself more deeply and gradually become more conscious of his subconscious patterns and survival awareness. Through this journey, he discovered that combining Family Constellations with coaching is the approach that best allows him to support others in finding greater peace within themselves and their family system. After several years of working with others, he now shares what he has learned to support each person's own journey toward deeper self-understanding and inner peace. Contact Rutger Here

name: Chie Miyagawa
bio: Chie Miyagawa comes from Japan. She worked as a nurse and has practiced yoga for over 15 years. She completed her 200-hour Yoga Teacher Training in Ubud, Bali. She loves creating calm, accessible classes where everyone can move at their own pace. Contact Chie Here

name: Dave Pastanella
bio: Dave Pastanella, known as The Joy Awakener, is a transformative coach, mentor, breathwork and embodiment facilitator, ecstatic dance DJ and music producer. His path began through a profound personal transformation. Six years ago, while facing a serious health condition, Dave undertook an 80-day fast that radically transformed his relationship with his body, mind and life, becoming the catalyst for a deeper journey into self-awareness, natural health and human transformation. Today, his work brings together breath, conscious movement, music and authentic human connection. Through breathwork, ice baths, authentic relating, coaching and ecstatic dance, Dave creates experiences that invite people out of the mind and back into the body, reconnecting with their inner joy, freedom and aliveness. As The Joy Awakener, his mission is to create spaces where transformation is not only understood, but embodied and experienced. Contact Dave Here

name: Eya Shaman
bio: Eya is an experienced embodied somatic dancer dedicated to body and emotions’ autonomous expression. Eya is also a certified Water therapist to explore your inner waters. Water is her main element towards music, experience and heart opening. She guides you through fluid expression of your intuitive and empowered movement. Sensual healing workshop is focused on sensual-self safe and liberated connection. Contact Eya Here

name: Karina Loyko
bio: Karina Loyko is an experienced yogainstructor, astrologer and energy worker. She has been teaching yoga since 2018 and holds certification in Vinyasa, Hatha and Kundalini Yoga, together with extensive knowledge in the chakra and energy systems. Contact Karina Here

name: Sandra Medina
bio: Sandra is a shamanic practitioner and intuitive guide, working from the heart and through the subtle energies that connect us all. Through energy work, intuition, connection with guides and heart-led conversation, she creates a safe and nurturing space for inner exploration, healing and transformation. Her work is about helping people journey inward, beyond the noise of the mind and the stories we carry, to reconnect with their own heart, inner wisdom and true essence. A journey of coming home to yourself. Contact Sandra Here

name: Valeria Serafim
bio: She is a seeker and someone who really loves studying about the universe. She has been travelling around the world for one year learning on the topic self knowledge. In Brazil, she had contact with xamanism, yoga and ayurveda since she was a child. Contact Valeria Here
